dataset_name: Mental Health & Clinical Psychotherapy SIV Dialogue Corpus
description: Comprehensive multi-stage clinical psychotherapy dialogue dataset for fine-tuning Large Language Models in evidence-based therapeutic communication, affective validation, and clinical protocol adherence.

components.State: Observed phenomenological state and canonical diagnostic classification of client presentation (e.g. trauma activation, interpersonal conflict, depressive rumination).
components.Intervention: Therapeutic technique and delivery style applied by the clinician/AI (e.g. Cognitive Reframing, Affective Validation, Somatic Grounding).
components.Value: Clinical goal / therapeutic target (e.g. contain distress, stabilize arousal, strengthen attachment security, support expression, shift cognition, build agency).

stages.purpose: Weak-supervision domain adaptation and dialogue candidate generation.
Empathetic validation and affective alignment with full SIV taxonomy.
Protocol-guided clinical psychotherapy dialogues (CBT, DBT, Somatic, Psychodynamic) with full SIV triples.
Ready-to-train ChatML/ShareGPT format with system prompt and full SIV metadata.
